messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Excellent! Your phone now has an excellent 5G signal, which is much better for MMS. Let's test if MMS is working now.

Please run the following on your phone:

**can_send_mms**

Let me know what result you get. If it says you can send MMS, you should be all set! If it still says you cannot send MMS, we'll need to check a couple more things (like Wi-Fi Calling settings and app permissions).

I tried, but my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages even though I now have a strong 5G signal. What else can we try? This is getting a bit frustrating.

Please execute the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
